briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google escalate frontier model race with new multimodal releases amid rising safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as frontier labs push multimodal capabilities while regulatory scrutiny grows. Compute constraints and talent wars dominate strategic planning. Prompt injection and multi-agent security remain top vulnerabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced reasoning; Google releases Gemini 3 Ultra. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and xAI's Grok-3 show gains in agentic tasks. DeepSeek and Meta open-source competitive models.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters. TSMC reports AI chip demand surging 40% QoQ.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve AGI-level performance on ARC-AGI before 2028?
